about_pullquote: We build gardens that families actually use and love for decades.
about_para_1: Lady Bay Garden Rooms was born from frustration. Too many garden buildings arrived as flat-pack kits, poorly fitted and falling apart within years. We decided to do it differently — sourcing premium materials, offering bespoke design, and installing every project to the highest standard. For over 15 years we've helped Nottingham homeowners add genuine living space to their gardens, whether it's a sunny studio, a weatherproof home office or a retreat for entertaining.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our obsession with detail and our willingness to listen. Every garden is different, every homeowner has different needs, and we treat each project as unique. Our customers return because we deliver on our promises, we're straightforward about costs, and we take responsibility for the entire process from site survey to handover. You're not buying a building; you're investing in years of enjoyment and a tangible boost to your home's value.

reviews.text: Had a garden room built last summer and it's transformed our whole house. The design process was painless, the lads were tidy and professional, and the finished room is absolutely stunning. Stayed warm all through winter too. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: We were terrified about planning permission and the cost spiralling, but Lady Bay guided us through the whole thing. The survey was free and honest, and they were right about everything they quoted. Built on time, built well. Genuinely brilliant experience.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Studio installed in our back garden for my wife's art business. Been using it daily for three months now and it's been perfect — warm, dry, proper lighting. The chaps who fitted it were friendly and respectful. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: James P.
